hero.title: Coordinate academic conferences efficiently with AI
hero.subtitle: ConferenceAI helps organisers, authors, and reviewers collaborate on a single platform. Automate routine tasks, track progress, and make data-driven decisions in real time.

features.title: Complete toolkit for every role
features.subtitle: From submissions and reviews to programme coordination and post-event analytics—every workflow is transparent, customisable, and AI-assisted.

submission.title: Smart paper intake
submission.description: Track each submission, auto-validate formatting, suggest relevant topics, and notify authors in seconds.

review.title: Accurate reviewer assignment
review.description: Recommend reviewers based on expertise, history, and conflicts of interest. Automated reminders keep timelines on track.

analytics.title: Real-time insights
analytics.description: Visual dashboards covering review progress, acceptance rates, session metrics, and engagement help organisers act quickly.
